Trend quality: STRONG_UP (contradicts the bearish structure — this metric may be lagging or measuring a different timeframe).

The SHORT_BIAS across 86 tokens means the entire alt market is in a markdown phase. Our ETC SHORT is aligned. Any LONG opened now is fighting 86/121 tokens. The only long-biased token is TON (conf 56 — weak signal).

Volatility is LOW (velocity SLOW, volume LOW). This is the hard_max_loss regime — positions enter, don't move enough to arm trail, and die. We need a volatility expansion for trail-based exits to work. Until then, expect high hard_max_loss rates regardless of direction. Short bias is still the right side — shorts at least profit from the downward drift even in low vol.
pattern_alerts:
PATTERN 1 (CRITICAL): LONG bias in a SHORT market. 48h: 62 LONGs vs 30 SHORTs. Longs: 24% WR, -2.12 USDT. Shorts: 33% WR, -0.04 USDT. We are systematically on the wrong side. WINNING side = SHORT every setup that pump-chain+ and bb-bounce-v2-long+ are taking long. Why weren't we on it? The signal library is long-heavy — most signals fire LONG by default. The 5m SHORT_BIAS regime should be suppressing long entries but isn't. This is a signal inventory problem: we need more short signals, not just fewer longs.

PATTERN 2 (CRITICAL): hard_max_loss = 100% loss rate, 33 trades, -2.83 USDT (48h). 27 of 33 were LONG. These are chop entries — price never reaches +0.40% trail arm. WINNING side = stay out entirely, or enter only when velocity is ACCELERATING (not SLOW). Current velocity is SLOW — every entry right now is a hard_max_loss candidate. The trail family (8W/8 + 3W/5) proves the system works WHEN trades reach trail. The problem is entry quality, not exit logic.

PATTERN 3 (URGENT): pump-chain+ at RSI 65-75 is a -0.82 USDT bleed over 48h (18 trades, 4W). Avg entry meta_rsi 66.2. This signal chases pumps at high RSI and most stall before trail arms. WINNING side = the rare monster that keeps going (CFX +5.68%). Base rate says most lose. The 65-75 band for longs is our single biggest loss source. SHORTING these same setups would have been the winning side — shorting overbought in a declining market.

PATTERN 4 (WARNING): doji-bottom-long and oversold-bounce+ are falling-knife machines. Combined: 8 trades, 0W, -0.79 USDT. All entries meta_rsi 32-41 LONG. WINNING side = SHORT continuation or wait for RSI to reclaim 55+. Low RSI in a DECLINING market = more downside, not a bounce. These signals need a trend filter (only fire when BTC above EMA300).

PATTERN 5 (INFO): volume-buildup- SHORT is 3/3, +0.27 USDT. Small n but perfect. Avg meta_rsi 54.8 — center of SHORT band. This is the setup we want more of. Our current ETC SHORT uses this signal. If it wins, this becomes a candidate for increased allocation.
